image_description: A blue and white striped fabric bib lying flat on a neutral beige surface. The bib features a curved neck opening with a red snap fastener at the top center. It has a rounded, shield-like body shape with visible stitching along the edges. There is a small embroidered detail or patch on the lower right side and a triangular fabric fold or pocket detail near the center.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the object as a bib and distinguish it from similar textiles like aprons or cloths.
To verify the continuity of the fabric edges and ensure the snap fastener is structurally connected to the neck band without fusion artifacts.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the stripes and stitching that might indicate AI generation issues like pattern bleeding.
To ensure the flat lay perspective is consistent and the object sits correctly on the background surface without floating.

focus_areas: Integrity of the snap fastener connection
Consistency of the stripe pattern across folds
Edge sharpness of the fabric against the background
Texture realism of the woven material
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the snap fastener; AI often struggles with small mechanical details attached to fabric. Check if the red snap looks physically plausible or if it melts into the fabric. Also, verify if the stripe pattern distorts naturally around the curves and folds of the bib.
